description: This PHP file defines the MailController class which manages email-related actions such as rendering email content based on a token, redirecting URLs encoded in emails, tracking email opens via embedded images, and handling associated metrics and geolocation data.

classes.name: MailController
classes.description: Controller class handling email rendering, URL redirection, link tracking, and email open tracking for the Goteo platform.

methods.name: indexAction
methods.description: Retrieves and renders email content from database based on a token, with optional geolocation tracking.

methods.name: urlAction
methods.description: Decodes a token to extract a URL and redirects the user, tracking the email open and geolocation.

methods.name: linkAction
methods.description: Uses a MailStats ID to track email opening and redirect to a stored URL, with geolocation tracking and metric updates.

methods.name: trackAction
methods.description: Returns a transparent GIF to track email opens when embedded as an image.
